newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Trust unit to issue subordinated bonds.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Trust unit to issue subordinated bonds.

text.p: Toyo Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Monday it would issue Euroyen subordinated bonds of 50 billion yen through its overseas unit and would also issue Euroyen convertible bonds worth 50 billion yen.
Toyo Trust will issue fixed-to-floating rate undated exchangeable subordinated guaranteed bonds, worth 50 billion yen, through TTB Finance Cayman Ltd, a bank spokesman said.
Toyo Trust itself will issue 50 billion yen worth convertible bonds in order to prepare for the exchange of TTB Finance-issued bonds to Toyo Trust shares, the bank said in a statement.
